results.description:
Tucked away among the pines is the hidden gem of Yosemite Creek campground. Accessing this campground is an adventure down a rutted, 5-mile, single-lane dirt road.  Motorhomes and trailers are NOT allowed.Yosemite Creek campground is a primitive campground with vault toilets and  no drinking water . A seasonal creek runs through the campground but    water must be boiled and/or treated    before drinking. Do not rely on creek water being available;  bring water!  
Granite boulders abound and the peaceful Yosemite Creek meanders through the campground on its way to Yosemite Valley. Bring your comfy chairs and hammocks and let the sounds of nature whisk you away from the busyness of day-to-day life. 
Head to Tuolumne Meadows for breathtaking views and a multitude of day hiking opportunities. Tenaya Lake is a great place to relax and swim or canoe. Yosemite Valley offers restaurants, museums, bike paths, day hikes and world-famous climbing. Don't forget about the Pioneer History center in Wawona, and of course, the Mariposa Grove of giant sequoias. Be prepared to make your own fun here-take delight in the quiet and give your screens a rest.  
Your adventure awaits! Hiking, swimming, bouldering, napping (some of us are tired!), bird watching; the possibilities are as great as your imagination. Be sure to bring bug spray and sunscreen, plenty of water, and dress in layers as the weather can rapidly change at this elevation.
results.name: Yosemite Creek Campground

results.description:
Staying at Porcupine Flat Campground requires reservations. No first come, first serve sites are available.   The campground typically opens in late-June and closes mid-October. The opening date varies depending on the opening of the Tioga Road and related seasonal facility and road work.  Porcupine Flat Campground is located off the Tioga Road about 30 minutes west of Tuolumne Meadows and over an hour from Yosemite Valley. RVs and Trailers are not recommended for the narrow roads in this more primitive campground. At an elevation of 8,100 feet (2,500 m) elevation, the campground is near Porcupine Creek, which is the only water source (must be filtered, treated, or boiled). The Porcupine Creek Trailhead is nearby. There are no visitor services close to the campground.  For additional park information, call (209)372-0200 or visit www.nps.gov/yose Yosemite National Park covers nearly 1,200 square miles (3,100 square km) in the Sierra Nevada, with elevations ranging from about 2,000 feet (600 m) to 13,000 ft (4,000 m). Yosemite receives 95% of its precipitation between October and May (and over 75% between November and March). Most of Yosemite is blanketed in snow from about November through May. (The Valley can be rainy or snowy in any given winter storm.)  

 Porcupine Flat is situated along a seasonal creek which is it's only source of water. Creek water must be treated and/or boiled before consuming.  
Just 25 miles away is Yosemite Valley, an awe-inspiring landscape containing many of the famous features for which Yosemite National Park is known. Hiking trails and bike paths are abundant in the valley. Rafting the Merced River is a fun way to cool down on a summer day when water levels are sufficient. Yosemite Valley also offers numerous guided bus tours, educational programs, museums, ranger-led activities, and an art center with workshops. 
 The Tioga Road offers a 39-mile scenic drive past forests, meadows, lakes and granite domes. Tuolumne Meadows embodies the high-country of the Sierra Nevada, with its broad sub-alpine meadows and granite peaks. Several trailheads line the road offering hikes to beautiful, secluded areas that can only be accessed and enjoyed by foot. 
 Beautiful Hetch Hetchy Reservoir, just 23 miles from Crane Flat, is home to spectacular scenery and numerous wilderness trailheads. 
Yosemite's trails, cliffs, roads and rivers provide endless recreational activities for any kind of visitor. Hiking, biking, rock climbing, fishing, horseback riding, rafting, auto touring, and photography are all very popular activities within the park. The White Wolf area has hiking and backpacking opportunities that begin near the campground, such as Lukens Lake, Harden Lake and the Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne. The Crane Flat area, 23 miles west, offers many other hiking opportunities such as Tuolumne and Merced Groves of Giant Sequoias, both of which require a 2.5 to 3-mile roundtrip hike to view. Tuolumne Meadows and all it's High Sierra wonder lie 25 miles to the east, where many beautiful day and overnight excursions await. 
 The Tioga Road offers a 39-mile scenic drive past forests, meadows, lakes, and granite domes. The road’s elevation ranges from 6,200 feet to just under 10,000 feet. Tuolumne Meadows embodies the high-country of the Sierra Nevada and is a good starting point for countless hikes. There is little to no cell service along the road. 
For facility specific information, please call (209) 372-4025.Porcupine Flat is extremely primitive and has no connectivity or drinking water. Basic amenities include vault toilets, trash/recycling collection, food storage lockers, fire rings and picnic tables.  Wood and charcoal fires are permitted when the campground is open.  For a map of the campground, visit  https://www.nps.gov/yose/planyourvisit/porcupinecamp.htm
results.name: Porcupine Flat Campground

results.description:
There is no drinking water provided here. Restrooms are portable toilets.    Staying at White Wolf Campground requires reservations.   White Wolf typically opens mid-July and closes mid to late September, depending on the opening of the Tioga Road and related seasonal facility and road work.  White Wolf Campground is located off the Tioga Road between Tuolumne Meadows and Crane Flat, approximately an hour from Yosemite Valley at 8,000 feet (2,400 m). The campground is tucked into the forest about a mile from Tioga Road near White Wolf Lodge. Trailheads nearby lead to Lukens and Harden Lakes and the area is popular for those accessing other wilderness destinations. Minimal services may be available at White Wolf Lodge (if open). There are no other visitor services close to the campground.Yosemite's trails, cliffs, roads and rivers provide endless recreational activities for any kind of visitor. Hiking, biking, rock climbing, fishing, horseback riding, rafting, auto touring, and photography are all very popular activities within the park. The White Wolf area has hiking and backpacking opportunities that begin near the campground, such as Lukens Lake, Harden Lake and the Grand Canyon of the Tuolumne. The Crane Flat area, 23 miles west, offers many other hiking opportunities such as Tuolumne and Merced Groves of Giant Sequoias, both of which require a 2.5 to 3-mile roundtrip hike to view. Tuolumne Meadows and all it's High Sierra wonder lie 25 miles to the east, where many beautiful day and overnight excursions await. 
Seasonal facilities include potable water (not available in 2025), flush toilets (not available in 2025), trash/recycling collection, food storage lockers, fire rings, picnic tables, staff/host on-site, and an amphitheater.  NOTE: White Wolf is open but with portable toilets and NO DRINKING WATER.   Wood and charcoal fires are permitted when the campground is open.  There is no cell phone reception, no internet connectivity, no camp store, no ice or firewood for sale, no laundry facilities, no dump station and no showers.Yosemite National Park covers nearly 1,200 square miles (3,100 square km) in the Sierra Nevada, with elevations ranging from about 2,000 feet (600 m) to 13,000 ft (4,000 m). Yosemite receives 95% of its precipitation between October and May (and over 75% between November and March). Most of Yosemite is blanketed in snow from about November through May. The Valley can be rainy or snowy in any given winter storm. 
Groceries: Yosemite Valley, Crane Flat (a small convenience store in the gas station ) and Tuolumne Meadows ( convenience store and grill) or Lee Vining. 
 Restaurants:  Yosemite Valley or Lee Vining. 
 Post Office:  Yosemite Valley, Tuolumne Meadows 
 Showers: Yosemite Valley at Curry Village and Housekeeping Camp 
 Dump Station: Available all year in Yosemite Valley in Upper Pines Campground.

cnr.description: 16-character CNR: 2-letter state, 2-letter establishment, 2-digit court, 6-digit serial, 4-digit year (e.g. DLND010000012024). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{4}[0-9]{12}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Public case status record of a district-court case identified by its 16-character CNR (ep-view-cnr-history, cnr_status/viewCNRHistory). No CAPTCHA is involved: the portal answers this call with the full record once a session is open. Returns the court, case type, filing/registration/e-filing numbers and dates, the status block (first hearing, next hearing or decision date, case stage or nature of disposal, court number and judge; every row is also kept verbatim in status_fields), petitioners and respondents with their advocates, acts and sections, the hearing history and the interim and final order rows. Dates are kept exactly as the portal prints them (dd-mm-yyyy in tables, '02nd January 2024' in the status block). An unknown CNR is not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `acts` | object[] |  |
| `case_stage` | string | Pending cases only, e.g. 'Pre-Charge Evidence'. |
| `case_status` | string | Disposed cases print 'Case disposed'; pending cases have no such row (null). |
| `case_type` | string | '<short> - <long>' as printed, e.g. 'Misc DJ - MISC. CASES FOR DJ and ADJ'. |
| `cnr` | string | The CNR as the portal prints it (upper case). |
| `court_name` | string | Court establishment heading, e.g. 'District and Sessions Judge,New Delhi, PHC'. |
| `court_number_and_judge` | string | e.g. '52-District Judge-01'. |
| `decision_date` | string | Disposed cases only. |
| `disposed` | boolean | true when the status block carries a Decision Date or a 'disposed' Case Status. |
| `efiling_date` | string | null when the portal prints '-'. |
| `efiling_number` | string | null when the portal prints the row blank. |
| `filing_date` | string | dd-mm-yyyy as printed. |
| `filing_number` | string |  |
| `final_orders` | object[] | Empty for pending cases. |
| `first_hearing_date` | string | As printed in the status block, e.g. '02nd January 2024'. |
| `history` | object[] |  |
| `interim_orders` | object[] |  |
| `nature_of_disposal` | string | Disposed cases only, e.g. 'Uncontested--DISPOSED'. |
| `next_hearing_date` | string | Pending cases only. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `petitioners` | object[] |  |
| `registration_date` | string | dd-mm-yyyy as printed. |
| `registration_number` | string |  |
| `respondents` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string | The portal's CNR search page; the record itself is only reachable through the session-bound POST. |
| `status_fields` | object[] | Every row of the status block verbatim, in page order. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.overview:
Magnum Opus: A Private Collection of Exceptional Art and Objects Through the Ages has been conceived as four distinct but interconnected chapters, each organized around a unifying theme rather than a traditional category framework, reflecting the deeply cross-disciplinary nature of the collection Itself.


ACT I: The Magnum Opus Evening Auction launches the series with a selection of the collection's exceptional masterworks, bringing together fine art, ancient sculpture, Islamic works of art and courtly carpets, furniture, and decorative arts in a single auction that mirrors the collector's instinct for dialogue across Disciplines. 


Illustrating the scope of the collection, you have one of the Evening Auction’s most arresting pairings: a cuirassed marble torso of a Roman emperor, the only such example in private hands with an extensive documented provenance extending back more than two centuries, and a small, early print of Richard Avedon's celebrated portrait of Marilyn Monroe from 1957, one of the defining images of 20th century photography. Two icons of presence and power, separated by two millennia, united in a single Room.


RSVP to the live auction here.

value.description:
The Workshop (L’atelier), by Pablo Picasso, 1927.

  • Pablo Picasso (Spanish, 1881-1973).
  • Etching and aquatint on Wove paper.
  • Hand-signed and numbered.
  • This work is presented unframed.


This etching is hand signed in red ink by the artist "Picasso" at the lower left margin. It is also hand numbered in red ink from the edition of 150, above the signature. It was published by Ambroise Vollard, Paris in an edition of 150 signed and numbered impressions in the 1927.


Other impressions of this subject can be found in the collections of The McNay, San Antonio, Texas; The Portland Art Museum, Oregon; The Museum of Modern Art (MoMA), New York and the Brooklyn Museum, New York.

value.catalogue_note:
The Vollard Suite is Picasso’s most important series of etchings. Created in bouts of fervent activity between 1930 and 1937, the series was retrospectively named for Ambroise Vollard, the great Parisian print publisher and art dealer behind its creation. The wide-ranging source imagery is partially autobiographical—perhaps most apparent across the fifteen prints detailing the narrative arc of the Minotaur, the half-man, half-beast figure with whom Picasso related deeply. The art critic Robert Hughes wrote that Picasso “was the Minotaur in a canvas-and-paper labyrinth of his own construction,” and indeed to the artist, the Minotaur represented the turmoil of his own uncontrollable desires (Robert Hughes, “The Artist Pablo Picasso”, Time, 1998). That turmoil is most directly observed in the depictions of Picasso, often as the Minotaur, with Marie-Thérèse Walter, the artist's young lover, nearly thirty years his junior. 


Marie-Thérèse’s presence in the suite ranges from serving as a sculptor's model to dreaming of Ovid’s Metamorphoses. In the present image, one of the strongest and most compositionally complex in the series, she is guiding the blind and helpless Minotaur through the night. The Minotaur, who has already undergone a transformation from young and inquisitive faun to fully-fledged and wildly savage beast, has been blinded and enfeebled. The young Marie-Thérèse holds a white dove while their journey is watched by three fishermen, witnesses from the ordinary world to a bizarre mythological drama. Picasso employs every resource at his disposal: the distorted surrealist setting, the Grecian profile of Marie-Thérèse that hints at cubist depictions, and his mastery and combination of the intaglio mediums in a single image.


Minotaure aveugle guidé par Marie-Thérèse au pigeon dans une nuit étoilée is representative of Picasso's dominance of the 20th century. His fame extended past the worlds of art, politics and culture—Hughes writes that “more people have heard of him than ever heard the names, let alone saw the work, of Michelangelo, Rembrandt or Cézanne while they were alive” (Robert Hughes, “Anatomy of a Minotaur”, Time, 1998). That level of recognition befits an artist consumed as equally by genius as he was by his lust for creation. To make art was, for Picasso, to live. Much like the Minotaur, that creative lust was inherent and uncontrollable: the anguish across the face of the Minotaur in the subject work carries within it the feverish emotion and mastery of the medium that willed Pablo Picasso to his status as an icon of modern art.

post.description: Start here for any free-text question (artist, title, sale number, auction name). Filter with type (Lot, Auction, Buy Now, Artist, Article, Private Sale), location, department or available. Follow a Lot hit's id into lot, an Auction hit's id into auction / auction_lots, a Buy Now hit's url into buy_now_item. Algolia serves at most 1000 hits per query: narrow with filters for deep history.

page.description:

query.description: Free text; empty or omitted browses the index with the filters alone.

career_site.description: Any URL of an employer's SuccessFactors career site (custom domain such as https://jobs.fraunhofer.de/, https://careers.ey.com/ or https://basf.jobs/; a bare domain, a /search/ results URL with q, locationsearch and optionsFacetsDD_* parameters, or a posting URL are fine). Requires job_id.

job_id.description: A search_jobs job_id. Requires career_site. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,15}(-[a-z]{2,3}_[A-Z]{2})?$.

locale.description: Language version to read, e.g. en_US; defaults to the posting's own. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2,3}_[A-Z]{2}$.

url.description: A posting URL: https://{career site}/[site path/]job/{slug}/{id}/, where id is numeric (1425737233) or requisition id plus locale (141923-en_US). Alternative to career_site + job_id.

200.description:
Read one posting from a SuccessFactors career site: title, posting and requisition ids, location, posted and valid-through dates (schema.org JobPosting microdata), employment type and every labelled field the posting page shows, hiring organization, job segments, apply URL and the full description as text and HTML.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apply_url` | string | The posting's apply link on the career site; null when the page has none. |
| `attribution` | string | Source attribution. |
| `career_site` | object | The career site that answered (after any redirect, e.g. a jobs2web.com tenant host to the employer's domain). |
| `description_html` | string | Full description HTML as the site serves it; null exactly when description_text is. |
| `description_text` | string | Full description as plain text with line breaks. Null only on sites whose posting body is rendered in the browser by a custom plugin (reported as partial coverage). |
| `employment_type` | string | A field labelled as employment, contract or job type, when the page shows one. |
| `fields` | object[] | Every labelled posting field the page shows (location, date, requisition id, custom fields...). |
| `hiring_organization` | string | JobPosting hiringOrganization. |
| `job_id` | string | Posting id from the canonical posting URL. |
| `job_segments` | string[] | JobPosting industry segments the platform assigns (e.g. Engineering, CAD); empty when none. |
| `layout` | string | classic: posting page with schema.org JobPosting microdata and labelled fields; unify: newer Career Site Builder page (title, description, ids and apply link; dates and location are not marked up). |
| `locale` | string | Language of the page as the platform names it, e.g. de_DE. |
| `location` | string | Location: JobPosting streetAddress (e.g. 'Stuttgart, DE, 70569'), else the listed location fields; null on unify pages. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | When the source was read (Unix ms). |
| `posted_date` | string | JobPosting datePosted (YYYY-MM-DD); the platform refreshes it when a posting is reposted. |
| `posted_text` | string | Date field as the page renders it, when shown. |
| `requisition_id` | string | Requisition id: from the posting URL on unify pages, otherwise a field labelled as one (Requisition ID, Job ID, Stellen-ID, Kennziffer, Reference...); null when the page shows none. |
| `title` | string | Posting title. |
| `url` | string | Canonical posting URL. |
| `valid_through` | string | JobPosting validThrough (YYYY-MM-DD), when the employer set a closing date. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.

value.description_html:
Die besondere Stärke des Fraunhofer-Instituts für Elektronische Nanosysteme ENAS liegt in der Entwicklung von Smart Systems - sogenannten intelligenten Systemen für verschiedenartige Anwendungen. Die Systeme verbinden Elektronikkomponenten, Mikro- und Nanosensoren und -aktoren mit Schnittstellen zur Kommunikation. Fraunhofer ENAS entwickelt Einzelkomponenten, die Technologien für deren Fertigung aber auch Systemkonzepte und Systemintegrationstechnologien und überführt sie in die praktische Nutzung. Fraunhofer ENAS begleitet Kundenprojekte von der Idee über den Entwurf, die Technologieentwicklung oder Umsetzung anhand bestehender Technologien bis hin zum getesteten Prototyp.

 

Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung

Für Ihre Initiativbewerbung teilen Sie uns bitte mit:

  • in welches Fachgebiet / welchen Themenbereich der Verwaltung Sie sich einbringen möchten
  • welche Erfahrungen Sie mitbringen
  • ab wann Sie zur Verfügung stehen können
  • Ihre Gehaltsvorstellung


Wir bitten um Übersendung vollständiger Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse).

 

Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein

  • Sie haben eine eigenverantwortliche und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, sind zuverlässig und haben ein hohes Maß an Lernbereitschaft.
  • Sie verfügen über Organisationstalent, Kreativität und Hands-On-Mentalität.
  • Auch Sozialkompetenz, Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit und Belastbarkeit zeichnen Sie aus.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Englischkenntnisse runden Ihr Profil ab.

 

Was wir für Sie bereithalten

  • ein spannendes und interdisziplinäres Arbeitsumfeld mit Verantwortung und Raum für Ihre Ideen
  • ein offenes, motiviertes Team, flache Hierarchien sowie modernste technische Ausstattung
  • eine von Kollegialität geprägte Unternehmenskultur
  • ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit Jahressonderzahlung nach TVöD Bund, 30 Urlaubstagen, Jobticket und betrieblicher Altersvorsorge (VBL)
  • vielfältige Weiterbildungs- und Qualifizierungsmöglichkeiten 
  • optimale Work-Life-Balance durch flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie unterschiedliche Unterstützungsangebote (z.B. mobiles Arbeiten) zur Vereinbarkeit von Privatleben und Beruf

 

Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern. 

Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen basieren auf dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD). Zusätzlich kann Fraunhofer leistungs- und erfolgsabhängige variable Vergütungsbestandteile gewähren.

Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft. 

Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt, und machen Sie einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Ihrer Online-Bewerbung erhalten Sie eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Ihnen, wie es weitergeht.

post.description: Start here with any career-site URL running on SAP SuccessFactors / jobs2web (rmkcdn.successfactors.com assets, /job/{slug}/{id}/ posting URLs). Read `facets` for filterable fields, page with next_offset, then call get_job with a row's url (or career_site + job_id) for the full description.

career_site.description: Any URL of an employer's SuccessFactors career site (custom domain such as https://jobs.fraunhofer.de/, https://careers.ey.com/ or https://basf.jobs/; a bare domain, a /search/ results URL with q, locationsearch and optionsFacetsDD_* parameters, or a posting URL are fine).

filters.description: Facet filters, ANDed: each {field, value} uses a `field` from a previous search_jobs `facets`. Values are what the site stores, not the label shown: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes for country (DE), language codes for lang (en, de), and the displayed text for other fields (exact match; a value the site doesn't know returns no results). When omitted, optionsFacetsDD_* parameters of a pasted search URL apply. Not available on sitemap-backed sites.

locale.description: Site language as the platform names it, e.g. de_DE or en_US; defaults to the site's default. Pattern: ^[a-z]{2,3}_[A-Z]{2}$.

location.description: Free-text location search (the site's locationsearch), e.g. Berlin. When omitted a pasted URL's locationsearch applies.

offset.description:
Result offset (the site's startrow): 0 for the first page, then the previous page's next_offset.

Provider reference: minimum 0; maximum 100000; default 0.

query.description: Keyword search (the site's q). Omit to list everything; when omitted a pasted URL's q applies.

200.description:
Search one SuccessFactors career site's open postings through its own /search/ page: keyword, location text and the site's facet filters (country, city, custom fields as each site exposes them), the site's page of results (25 on most sites) with offset paging and the total. Rows carry title, job id, URL, location, posted date, department and facility when the site lists them, plus every listed field with its label. Sites whose search results render only in the browser (newer Career Site Builder widget) are searched through their sitemap instead (title null, URL words matched).

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `jobs` as the primary payload key.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `department` | string | Department field, when listed. |
| `facility` | string | Facility field, when listed (some sites use it for the institute or business unit). |
| `fields` | object[] | Every column or tile field the site lists for the posting, with its label. |
| `job_id` | string | Posting id: the numeric jobs2web id, or requisition id plus locale (141923-en_US) on newer sites. Pass it with career_site to get_job. |
| `last_modified` | string | Sitemap lastmod (YYYY-MM-DD) for sitemap-backed results; null for search-page results. |
| `location` | string | Location as listed (location field, or city/state/country, or a column labelled as a location); null when the site's list shows none. |
| `posted_text` | string | Posting date as the site renders it (date field), e.g. 'Oct 9, 2026' or '09.10.2026'; null when not listed. |
| `slug_text` | string | Words of the posting URL slug, usually location and title, e.g. 'Madrid AI Data Architect (mfd)'. |
| `title` | string | Posting title as listed; null for sitemap-backed results (read it with get_job). |
| `url` | string | Public posting page. |

value.description:
The Stephen Sondheim Theatre is a treasured gem within the heart of New York City. Located in the bustling Times Square district, it stands proudly, retaining its historical charm midst contemporary edifices. The theatre, formerly known as Henry Miller's Theatre, is deeply rooted in theatrical history, having hosted numerous Broadway classics since its inception in 1918. It boasts art nouveau architecture bathed in gentle, welcoming lights, with intricate details that add to its grandeur. A walk inside reveals a relaxing ambiance with ornamented ceilings, beautiful chandeliers, red velvet seats, and a sizeable stage that brings performances to life. Dedicated to the legendary composer Stephen Sondheim, the theatre's rich legacy continues by staging some of the most critically acclaimed plays, musicals, and performances, all enjoyed from the comfort of its 1,055 seats. 

**How to Get There** 
Stephen Sondheim Theatre is conveniently located at 124 West 43rd Street, accessible via various modes of transportation. Visitors can reach the theatre by subway, taking the B, D, F, or M train to 42nd Street/Bryant Park or the 1, 2, 3, 7, N, Q, R, S, or W train to Times Square/42nd Street. Buses M5, M7, M20, M42, or M104 also offer routes to Times Square. For those who prefer driving, several paid parking garages are available nearby.

post.description: Finding Taiwan public tenders by keyword, agency or case number, or listing notices published in a date window; then call tender_detail with a result's pk.

case_no.description: Agency case number (標案案號), e.g. CGH115032. The site allows a case-number search without a date window.

category.description:
Procurement category (採購性質): works=工程類, goods=財物類, services=勞務類. Default all.

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "works", "goods", "services"].

date_type.description:
Date filter: today (當日 notices), open_for_bidding (等標期內, deadline not yet passed), range (公告日期 between start_date and end_date). Default: range when start_date or end_date is given, otherwise today. Ignored when only case_no is used.

Provider reference: allowed values ["today", "open_for_bidding", "range"].

end_date.description: Notice date window end, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Taipei). Pattern: ^\d{4}[-/]\d{2}[-/]\d{2}$.

org_id.description: Agency code (機關代碼) from lookup_agency, e.g. 3.13.31.25 or A.17.1.

page.description:
1-based page number; use the previous call's next_page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000.

page_size.description:
Rows per page; the site offers 10, 20, 50 or 100. Default 50.

Provider reference: allowed values ["10", "20", "50", "100"].

start_date.description: Notice date window start, Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD (Asia/Taipei). Pattern: ^\d{4}[-/]\d{2}[-/]\d{2}$.

tender_name.description: Keyword matched against the tender name (標案名稱), e.g. 資訊系統.

tender_type.description:
Notice type: tender (招標公告, default), appeal (公開徵求), public_read (公開閱覽), forecast (政府採購預告).

Provider reference: allowed values ["tender", "appeal", "public_read", "forecast"].

tender_way.description:
Tendering method (招標方式); default all. open=公開招標, e_quotation=公開取得電子報價單, quotation_or_proposal=公開取得報價單或企劃書, restricted_evaluated=經公開評選或公開徵求之限制性招標, selective_list=選擇性招標(建立合格廠商名單), selective_list_invite=選擇性招標(後續邀標), selective_case=選擇性招標(個案), e_bidding=電子競價, restricted=限制性招標(未經公開評選).

Provider reference: allowed values ["all", "open", "e_quotation", "quotation_or_proposal", "restricted_evaluated", "selective_list", "selective_list_invite", "selective_case", "e_bidding", "restricted"].
